stories.h: SP Industrial launches six new enterprise SSDs up to 15.3 TB with PCIe Gen 5
stories.s: SP Industrial announced six enterprise SSD models across E1.S, U.2, M.2 2280 and 2.5" SATA, offering capacities up to 15.3 TB, PCIe Gen 5 interfaces and up to 3 DWPD endurance.

stories.h: FADU unveils world's first File-Semantic SSD (FS-SSD) at OCP 2026
stories.s: Data‑center chipmaker FADU announced its File‑Semantic SSD, which processes files inside the drive via a Gen 6 controller, claiming up to 2.5× performance over Gen 5 and power use under 28 W active.

stories.h: Pulsar Feinmann F01 Noctua Edition gaming mouse reviewed with 42,000 CPI sensor
stories.s: TechPowerUp reviews Pulsar's F01 Noctua Edition mouse featuring a 40 mm Noctua fan, 42,000 CPI XS‑2 sensor, 100 M click optical switches and a 500 mAh battery delivering 5‑10 hours of use.

stories.h: LattePanda Mu Ultra AI development kit launched with Intel Core Ultra 5 226V
stories.s: TechPowerUp reviews the LattePanda Mu Ultra compute module featuring an Intel Core Ultra 5 226V, 16 GB LPDDR5X‑8533 memory and Arc 130V GPU, sold as a $643 kit with carrier board and cooler.

stories.h: Corsair Vanguard Air 99 Wireless keyboard reviewed
stories.s: TechPowerUp reviews Corsair's Vanguard Air 99 Wireless keyboard, a 99% form‑factor, low‑profile mechanical keyboard with wired/wireless options and extra Stream Deck keys.

stories.h: Microsoft Surface Laptop Ultra reviewed with prices up to $3,699 and up to 128GB RAM
stories.s: Reviews note the Ultra’s powerful RTX Spark N1X chip, premium design and high price, with configurations from $2,599 to $3,699 and memory options up to 128GB, though AI performance is the main selling point.

stories.h: Thermaltake announces Dockpower FI detachable modular PSU for compact cases
stories.s: Thermaltake revealed the Dockpower FI, a modular desktop PSU with a separable connector section aimed at easier cable routing in compact and dual‑chamber cases.

stories.h: Red Magic unveils 5K MiniLED monitor with 5,184 zones, $856 price
stories.s: Red Magic announced a 5K MiniLED monitor featuring a 5,184-zone backlight, 180 Hz at 5K or 330 Hz at 2K, and a $856 price, slated for December 2026 release.

stories.h: IDC reports global PC shipments down 20.1% YoY in Q3 2026
stories.s: IDC data shows global PC shipments fell about 20.1% year‑over‑year in Q3 2026, pressured by rising DRAM and SSD costs and AI‑driven component demand.

stories.h: Googlebook OLED notebooks show gray blacks, firmware fix promised
stories.s: Google acknowledges that some OLED-equipped Googlebook laptops cannot display true black, showing a dark‑grey level, and plans a firmware update to correct the issue.

stories.h: ASUS lists white ROG Strix X870E-A Gaming WiFi7 Neo AM5 motherboard
stories.s: ASUS announced the ROG Strix X870E-A Gaming WiFi7 Neo, a white‑themed AM5 motherboard with X870E chipset, 16+2+2 power stages, DDR5, PCIe 5.0, Wi‑Fi 7 and USB4. Pricing varies by region.

stories.h: Intel Core 5 205H shows 19,390 PassMark multi-thread score
stories.s: PassMark lists the upcoming mobile Intel Core 5 205H with eight cores, twelve threads and a 19,390 multi-thread score, about 15.7% higher than the i5-13420H.

stories.h: SK hynix unveils H-TPU SSD controller architecture with 100+ specialized cores
stories.s: SK hynix presented the H-TPU, a new SSD controller architecture using over 100 small specialized cores that claim 2.5% power of a conventional CPU core, targeting enterprise PCIe 6.0 drives.

stories.h: ViewSonic launches 26.5" 4K 120Hz QD-OLED monitor VG2782Z-4K in China for $786
stories.s: ViewSonic introduced the VG2782Z-4K, a 26.5-inch QD-OLED monitor with 3840×2160 resolution, 120 Hz refresh, 140 W USB‑C charging and integrated KVM, priced at CNY 5,262 (~$786) in China.

stories.h: MSI launches limited MSI GeForce RTX 5080 16G COD MW4 EDITION OC graphics card
stories.s: MSI announced a limited-edition RTX 5080 16GB graphics card themed after Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, featuring a yellow‑painted TRIO FROZR 4 cooler and a transparent backplate, with sales starting Oct 23, 2026 in selected countries.

stories.h: Colorful unveils iGame X870E ULTRA-S AM5 motherboard with 192GB DDR5-6600 support
stories.s: Colorful announced the iGame X870E ULTRA-S motherboard for AMD AM5, claiming up to 192GB DDR5-6600 memory at CL28, 16 PCIe Gen6/CXL Gen3 MCIO interfaces and PCIe 5.0 graphics support, with no price or availability yet.

stories.h: GlobalFoundries unveils 7nm-class FD‑SOI FDX Fusion node
stories.s: GlobalFoundries announced its new 7nm-class FD‑SOI process, FDX Fusion, targeting automotive, edge AI and industrial markets, with production slated for Dresden in 2028 and demo silicon in early 2027.

stories.h: Nvidia RTX Spark Superchip tested in Microsoft Surface Laptop Ultra with 20 CPU cores, 6144 CUDA cores, 128GB LPDDR5X-9400 RAM
stories.s: Tom's Hardware evaluated the RTX Spark platform on a Surface Laptop Ultra, noting it outperformed an M5 Max MacBook Pro in local AI benchmarks, completing tasks 25% faster on the Qwen 3.8 27B model.

stories.h: Elon Musk criticizes memory makers for 'extortionate' pricing, praises Micron's approach
stories.s: Elon Musk called out Samsung and SK hynix for high memory prices, highlighting Micron's 81% GAAP gross margin in Q4 FY2026, amid ongoing DRAM and HBM shortages.

stories.h: Two killed, one seriously hurt in explosion at Intel's Kiryat Gat plant
stories.s: An explosion suspected to be caused by a gas cylinder malfunction at Intel's Fab 28 in Kiryat Gat, Israel, killed two workers and injured another seriously, raising concerns about production impacts.

stories.h: Qualcomm, GFiber and Gemtek unveil Wi‑Fi 8 Premium Gateway for 20 Gig customers
stories.s: Qualcomm's Dragonwing NPro A8 Elite Platform will power GFiber's Wi‑Fi 8 Premium Gateway, built by Gemtek, for subscribers of GFiber's 20 Gig service, with rollout expected in 2027.

stories.h: SK hynix unveils H-TPU custom cores for SSD controllers to cut power use
stories.s: SK hynix announced its H-TPU, a tiny custom CPU core for SSD controllers that uses about 2.5% of a general‑purpose core's power and 4% of its area, aiming to offload repetitive I/O tasks as drive speeds increase.

stories.h: Intel outlines EMIB and Foveros packaging roadmap through 2030
stories.s: Intel detailed its future EMIB and Foveros advanced packaging plans, targeting finer bump pitches down to 25 µm, larger SiP sizes up to 12 reticles and glass-core substrates by 2030.

stories.h: Newegg bundles AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D PC build for $1,165.99, RAM effectively $151
stories.s: Newegg offers a combo of AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D CPU, Gigabyte X870E Elite WiFi7 motherboard, 32 GB DDR5‑6000 RAM, 2 TB NV5000 SSD, Cooler Master AIO and a game for $1,165.99, saving 23% off list price.

stories.h: Apple uses idle Macs as a virtual GPU cloud called “Minions”
stories.s: Apple researchers described “Minions,” a system that pools idle Macs’ Apple Silicon GPUs to run AI inference jobs, cutting queue times from hours to minutes, per an arXiv paper.

stories.h: Ledger reports $93 million crypto wallet supply‑chain hack, reviews sales and anti‑tamper policies
stories.s: Ledger confirmed a physical implant in wallets sold via reseller CryptoBilis that stole recovery phrases, causing $93 million losses, and is reviewing its sales, vendor verification and anti‑tamper measures.

stories.h: Nvidia RTX 50-series GPU prices in Japan up to 41.1% higher than US Amazon listings
stories.s: Tom's Hardware reports Japanese retail prices for Nvidia RTX 5080‑5060 Ti GPUs are 5.66%‑41.10% above US Amazon pre‑tax prices, reflecting supply pressure from AI demand and a planned RTX 5090 production halt.

stories.h: 32GB DDR5-6000 RAM-in qiyməti 450 dollara çatıb, keçən ildən bəri 500%-dən çox artıb
stories.s: Tom's Hardware qeyd edir ki, ən ucuz 32GB DDR5-6000 dəsti indi 449,97 dollar dəyərindədir. Bu, keçən ildən bəri qiymətin 500%-dən çox artmasını əks etdirir və III rübdə PC çatdırılmalarının 20% azalmasına töhfə verir.
stories.he: 32GB DDR5‑6000 RAM price hits $450, up over 500% since last year

stories.h: Framework Laptop 12 review shows higher price despite repairability
stories.s: Tom's Hardware finds the Framework Laptop 12 highly portable and repairable but priced $1,491 fully configured, about $200‑$300 above rivals, with a middling 1080p60 display and poor webcam.

stories.h: CXMT plans to launch first 4F² DDR5 RDIMM server memory by year-end
stories.s: CXMT president Cao Kanyu announced the company will release its first 4F² DRAM server DDR5 RDIMM by the end of 2026, using a vertical transistor design that reduces cell footprint by about one-third.

stories.h: Alienware AW3226Q 32" 4K OLED monitor reviewed at $699
stories.s: Tom's Hardware and PCWorld reviewed the Alienware AW3226Q 32-inch 4K OLED monitor, noting its bright TRS‑OLED panel, 165 Hz refresh, Dolby Vision support and solid value at $699, while citing limited USB‑C docking and lack of speakers.

stories.h: NVIDIA RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB price tops $1,200 in Japan
stories.s: Retail listings show the RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB now costs ¥139,800 (~$882) and the RTX 5080 16 GB ¥295,801 (~$1,867), representing up to 144% above MSRP due to soaring memory prices.

stories.h: GlobalFoundries to operate two new $10 B semiconductor fabs in Malta, NY
stories.s: GlobalFoundries will run two 300 mm fabs in Malta, New York, funded by a U.S.-Japan initiative totalling up to $21 billion, with production slated for 2029 and full capacity by 2033.

stories.h: Microsoft launches Xbox Nano Controller for $49.99
stories.s: Microsoft announced the pocket-sized Xbox Nano Controller, measuring just over five inches, weighing 3.5 ounces, and priced at $49.99, with pre‑orders open and launch on November 4 in 36 markets.

stories.h: Tuxedo launches Stellaris 16 Gen 8 laptop with Intel Core Ultra 9 290HX Plus and RTX 5070‑5090 options
stories.s: Tuxedo Computers introduced the Stellaris 16 Gen 8, a 16‑inch desktop‑replacement laptop featuring optional liquid cooling, Intel Core Ultra 9 290HX Plus CPUs and NVIDIA RTX 5070‑5090 GPUs, starting at €2,350.

stories.h: StarTech launches Dual-Monitor USB‑C Smart Dock with fleet management software
stories.s: StarTech's new Dual‑Monitor USB‑C Smart Dock (194N‑USBC‑SmartDock) adds remote fleet management, 4K 60 Hz dual displays, 96 W charging and a dedicated Dock Manager software for IT teams.

stories.h: Rambus unveils power‑management IC for upcoming LPDDR6 SOCAMM2 memory modules
stories.s: Rambus announced a new Power Management IC designed for low‑power, high‑performance LPDDR6 SOCAMM2 server memory modules, now sampling to lead customers.

stories.h: Cooler Master GPU Shield price drops to €29.99 in EU, warranty cut to two years
stories.s: Cooler Master reduced the EU price of its GPU Shield adaptor cable to €29.99 and shortened the warranty to two years, down from three years in the US and China.

stories.h: Lenovo raises Legion Go 2 price to $3,081.99
stories.s: Lenovo increased the price of the Legion Go 2 handheld with 32 GB RAM and 2 TB storage from $2,849 to $3,081.99, an $233 (8%) hike, while other Legion Go models also saw price jumps.

stories.h: NVIDIA 20 nüvəli Grace CPU və 6 144 nüvəli Blackwell iGPU ilə RTX Spark superçipini təqdim etdi
stories.s: NVIDIA RTX Spark superçipini elan edib. Çip 20 nüvəli Grace CPU və 6 144 CUDA nüvəli GeForce RTX Blackwell iGPU ilə təchiz olunub, DLSS 5 dəstəyi və anti-cheat uyğunluğu təqdim edir. RTX Spark 16 oktyabr tarixində Windows 11 kompüterləri üçün satışa çıxarılacaq.
stories.he: NVIDIA unveils RTX Spark superchip with 20-core Grace CPU and 6,144‑core Blackwell iGPU

stories.h: be quiet! launches Dark Power Pro 14 IO 1600W flagship PSU
stories.s: be quiet! unveiled its new Dark Power Pro 14 IO 1600W power supply, featuring ATX 3.1 compliance, 80 Plus Titanium efficiency, USB‑C telemetry and dual 12V‑2x6 connectors.

stories.h: Team Group releases T-Force XTREEM DDR5-6400 32 GB kit for gamers
stories.s: TechPowerUp reviews Team Group's T-Force XTREEM DDR5-6400 32 GB (2×16 GB) memory kit, featuring 32-39-39-84 timings at 1.35 V and targeting AMD gamers.

stories.h: NZXT releases H6 RGB+ full‑tower case with 7 fans and wrap‑around glass
stories.s: NZXT's 2026 H6 RGB+ full‑tower case adds a single‑piece wrap‑around glass panel, rear motherboard support and boosts fan count from four to seven, weighing 9.3 kg and measuring 420 × 292 × 448 mm.

stories.h: Gigabyte launches X870 Aorus Infinity motherboard at $800
stories.s: Gigabyte's new X870 Aorus Infinity motherboard, an updated Tachyon model, uses the AMD X870 chipset, supports DDR5-11400, and retails for $800, $50 above the Apex launch price.

stories.h: RTX 5090 price spikes to $5,000 in North America
stories.s: The RTX 5090, originally launched at $1,999, now costs at least $5,000 in North America according to price tracking, reflecting a significant market price increase.

stories.h: Mozilla releases Firefox 158 fixing 77 security flaws, adds AI form‑filling
stories.s: Firefox 158 launched for Windows, macOS, Linux and Android, introducing AI‑powered Smart Windows for form filling, JPEG XL support, and patches 77 security flaws including 30 high‑risk bugs.

stories.h: Microsoft releases Windows 11 update KB5127648 fixing mouse input stutter in games
stories.s: Microsoft confirmed a Windows 11 bug that could cause mouse input to stutter in some games and fixed it in the October 2026 update KB5127648 for builds 24H2, 25H2 and 26H2.

stories.h: Microsoft fixes record 1,416 security flaws in October 2026 Patch Tuesday
stories.s: Microsoft's October 2026 Patch Tuesday update addressed 1,416 vulnerabilities, including 85 critical flaws and 67 remote code execution issues, urging immediate installation.

stories.h: Alienware launches 27" QD-OLED gaming monitor AW2726DM for $350
stories.s: Alienware’s AW2726DM 27-inch 1440p QD-OLED monitor offers a 240Hz refresh rate and OLED quality at an everyday price of $350, though it lacks brightness, USB hub and full‑speed HDMI.

stories.h: HP EliteBook 6 G1q with Snapdragon X1 Plus gets mainline Linux support patches
stories.s: HP posted mainline kernel patches enabling full functionality of the EliteBook 6 G1q with Snapdragon X1P42100, covering keyboard, touchpad, touchscreen, USB, Ethernet, HDMI, Wi‑Fi, Bluetooth, audio, camera and fingerprint reader.

stories.h: Mesa 26.3 Rusticl driver benchmarked against AMD ROCm 10 on Ryzen AI Max+ 395
stories.s: Phoronix benchmarked the open-source Rusticl OpenCL driver in Mesa 26.3 against AMD's ROCm 10 driver on the AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 "Strix Halo" platform, noting Rusticl supports OpenCL 3.1 while ROCm offers OpenCL 2.1.

stories.h: Intel yeni süni intellekt akseleratoru GPU D-Seriyasının (Crescent Island) adını və texniki xüsusiyyətlərini açıqladı
stories.s: Intel Crescent Island süni intellekt akseleratoru ilə təchiz olunmuş GPU D-Seriyasını təqdim etdi. Hava soyutmalı PCIe kartında 1.3 PFLOPS FP8, 1.5 TB/s yaddaş zolağı genişliyi, 350 W TDP və 480 GB-ə qədər LPDDR5X yaddaş təklif olunur.
stories.he: Intel names and specs its new AI accelerator GPU D-Series (Crescent Island)

stories.h: HP OmniBook Ultra 16 AI notebook announced with NVIDIA RTX Spark, 20‑core Grace CPU and up to 128 GB unified memory
stories.s: HP unveiled the OmniBook Ultra 16 AI PC, a 16‑inch laptop featuring a 20‑core NVIDIA Grace CPU, Blackwell‑derived RTX GPU with 6,144 CUDA cores, up to 128 GB unified memory and a starting price of approx. $3,922, with orders beginning 29 Oct 2026.

stories.h: ASUS announces ROG Strix OLED XG27AQDMG Gen2 26.5" QHD 240Hz monitor
stories.s: ASUS will release the 26.5-inch ROG Strix OLED XG27AQDMG Gen2 gaming monitor with a 2560×1440 panel, 240Hz refresh rate and TrueBlack Glossy coating, arriving in Japan on 16 October 2026; price is not yet disclosed.

stories.h: ASUS announces ROG Strix XG27ACNS 27" monitor with up to 920Hz refresh
stories.s: ASUS unveiled the ROG Strix XG27ACNS, a 27-inch gaming monitor offering 2560×1440 at up to 475Hz, 1920×1080 at up to 620Hz, and 1280×720 at up to 920Hz, with ELMB‑Sync technology; price and release date are not yet disclosed.

stories.h: ADATA XPG MARS 980 BLADE SSD launches with up to 14,000 MB/s PCIe 5.0 read
stories.s: ADATA’s XPG MARS 980 BLADE PCIe 5.0 SSD, using a Silicon Motion SM2508 6nm controller, offers up to 14,000 MB/s sequential read, 10,000 MB/s write and 1,600,000 IOPS 4K random read, with a five‑year replacement‑first warranty.

stories.h: KIOXIA launches CM9-DLC enterprise SSD with liquid‑cooling, up to 32TB
stories.s: KIOXIA announced the CM9-DLC, an EDSFF E3.S PCIe 5.0 SSD with direct cold‑plate liquid cooling, dual‑port support and capacities up to 32 TB, delivering up to 14.8 GB/s read and 11 GB/s write speeds.

stories.h: Thermaltake launches OB360 360mm AIO cooler with unified fan frame
stories.s: Thermaltake's new OB360 AIO liquid cooler is rated for up to 360W TDP, uses a single 360mm fan frame, runs 500‑2000RPM (53.9CFM, 2.36mmH2O) and peaks at 32.3dB(A). It supports LGA1851, LGA1700, LGA115x, AM4 and AM5 sockets.

stories.h: Valve discontinues Index VR headset, discounts remaining stock to £367
stories.s: Valve announced the end of production for the Index headset, clearing out remaining units at £367 for the headset, £111 for controllers and £95 for the tether cable as it shifts focus to the new Steam Frame standalone VR device.

stories.h: ID‑Cooling launches Frozn A610 XL air cooler with 250W rating and 17mm fan
stories.s: ID‑Cooling unveiled the Frozn A610 XL at Computex 2026, a single‑tower air cooler rated for 250W that uses a slim 17mm AF‑12017 fan to maintain RAM clearance across AMD AM4/AM5 and Intel LGA115x, LGA1200, LGA1700, LGA1851 sockets.

stories.h: Sapphire launches Valor Mortis themed RX 9070 XT NITRO+ edition
stories.s: Sapphire unveiled a limited‑edition NITRO+ Radeon RX 9070 XT Valor Mortis Edition with custom backplate, shroud and ARGB, retaining the same RDNA 4 performance as the standard model, available through selected retailers later in October 2026.

stories.h: SteelSeries launches Rival 8K mouse with Ultra‑Wideband 8000Hz wireless
stories.s: SteelSeries introduced the Rival 8K mouse featuring Ultra‑Wideband wireless and true 8000Hz polling, priced at £169.99 for full‑size and mini versions, available globally.

stories.h: NVIDIA launches faster DLSS 5 model for RTX Spark laptops
stories.s: NVIDIA's new DLSS 5, using 3D‑Guided Neural Rendering, boosts frame rates up to 1.4x in NBA 2K27 Season 2 and will roll out to games like Hogwarts Legacy in November and RTX Spark laptops shipping Oct 16.

stories.h: PCSpecialist Cruiser Gallant prebuilt reviewed at £2599 with Ryzen 7 9850X3D and RX 9070 XT
stories.s: KitGuru reviews the PCSpecialist Cruiser Gallant prebuilt featuring an AMD Ryzen 7 9850X3D, Radeon RX 9070 XT, 32 GB DDR5 and a £2599 price, noting strong performance but loud default fan curve.

stories.h: Marvell launches Structera X 3406 and 3506 CXL memory expanders with up to 9TB capacity
stories.s: Marvell announced second‑gen Structera X CXL expanders (3406 and 3506) supporting CXL 3.2, PCIe 6.0, six downstream channels and up to 9TB (DDR4) or 6TB (DDR5) memory, with LZ4 compression up to 250GB/s.

stories.h: Colorful Battle-AX BA26M-G Micro-ATX case launches in China for approx. $37
stories.s: The Battle-AX BA26M-G case is now available at Chinese retailers for CNY 249 (about $37), offering a dual‑glass design, 390mm GPU clearance and support for 360mm radiators.

stories.h: Bosgame E7 Mini PC launches with Intel Core 3 100U for €449
stories.s: Bosgame introduced the E7 mini PC featuring a 6‑core Intel Core 3 100U processor, 16 GB RAM, 512 GB SSD and dual RJ‑45 ports, priced at €449.

stories.h: Xiaomi launches REDMI A27U 2027 27" 4K 75Hz monitor in China for about $179
stories.s: Xiaomi has started selling the REDMI A27U 2027 27-inch 4K IPS monitor in China at CNY 1,199 (≈$179), featuring 75Hz refresh, 400 nits brightness, 1,500:1 contrast and an adjustable stand.

stories.h: Thermalright launches Frozen Horizon 240 Digital AIO cooler priced at approx. $51
stories.s: Thermalright introduced the Frozen Horizon 240 Digital, a 240mm AIO liquid CPU cooler with a rotating digital pump display, priced at CNY 339 (~$51) in China and includes two TL‑Q12 fans.

stories.h: AOC launches Q27U4D 27" QD-OLED monitor with 96W USB‑C charging and KVM
stories.s: AOC introduced the Q27U4D, a 27‑inch QD‑OLED panel at 2560×1440 @ 144 Hz, priced at CNY 2,999 (~$448) with subsidies to CNY 2,706.55 (~$404), featuring 96 W USB‑C power delivery, KVM switch and 4 × 10 Gbps USB hub.

stories.h: Microsoft Surface Laptop Ultra 128GB model sells out in US store
stories.s: Microsoft's top‑spec Surface Laptop Ultra with 128GB unified memory and 1TB SSD, priced at $5,899.99, is now unavailable in the United States store, while lower‑memory versions remain on sale.

stories.h: Microsoft warns Windows 10/11 PCs may lose update access after May/June 2027
stories.s: Microsoft says Windows 10 Enterprise 2019 LTSC, Windows Server 2019 and 2016 must get certificate updates before May 17, 2027, or lose Windows Update connectivity; other Windows 10/11 versions need updates by June 19, 2027.

stories.h: HKC launches G7W White Edition 27" QHD 240Hz monitor priced around $158
stories.s: HKC released a white‑edition G7W 27‑inch QHD 240Hz Fast IPS gaming monitor in China, listed at CNY 1,054 (≈$158), with native 200Hz and overclocked 240Hz support.

stories.h: Titan Army launches 31.5" P326MV Ultra dual-mode 4K 200Hz/1080p 400Hz monitor at $581
stories.s: Titan Army's new 31.5-inch P326MV Ultra offers 3840×2160 at 200Hz or 1920×1080 at 400Hz, 2,304 Mini LED zones, 1ms GtG, and launches in China for CNY 3,888 (~$581).

stories.h: Gigabyte adds BIOS support for upcoming Intel LGA1700 CPUs on B760 and H610 boards
stories.s: Gigabyte released BIOS updates for its entire B760 and H610 motherboard ranges to support a future Intel LGA1700 processor generation expected in early 2027, extending the socket's lifespan.

stories.h: OneXPlayer X2 Air handheld PC launches in Japan for approx. $1,634
stories.s: One-Netbook released the OneXPlayer X2 Air in Japan, featuring an Intel Core Ultra 7 258V with Arc 140V graphics, 32 GB LPDDR5X‑8533 RAM, 1 TB SSD and a 10.95‑inch 2560×1600 touchscreen, priced at ¥258,000 (~$1,634).

stories.h: IDC reports global PC shipments fell 20.1% YoY in Q3 2026
stories.s: IDC's preliminary data shows worldwide PC shipments dropped to 62.7 million units in Q3 2026, a 20.1% YoY decline and 9.1% below Q2, with HP, Dell and Lenovo seeing the biggest falls.

stories.h: Gigabyte launches GO27Q32 27" QHD 320Hz QD-OLED monitor
stories.s: Gigabyte unveiled the GO27Q32, a 27-inch QHD gaming monitor with a 320Hz QD-OLED panel, 0.03ms response, 300 nits SDR and 1300 nits HDR brightness, and Nvidia G‑Sync Compatible/AMD FreeSync Premium support.

stories.h: Singularity Computers launches Portal ITX wall‑mount water‑cooling case for $299
stories.s: Singularity Computers introduced the Portal ITX wall‑mount case, an open‑frame Mini‑ITX chassis with integrated distribution plate, reservoir and D5 pump top, supporting dual 240mm or 280mm radiators.

stories.h: Razer launches Basilisk V4 gaming mouse lineup and Mouse Dock V2 Pro
stories.s: Razer unveiled the Basilisk V4 Pro and HyperSpeed mice with up to 50,000 DPI sensors, 200‑275 hour battery life, and a new Mouse Dock V2 Pro wireless charger; prices start at £109.00/$109.99/€119.99 for the Pro model.

stories.h: Gigabyte Aorus Master 16 gaming laptop launches with Ryzen 9 9955HX3D and RTX 5090
stories.s: Gigabyte unveiled the AORUS MASTER 16, featuring a Ryzen 9 9955HX3D 16‑core CPU, GeForce RTX 5090 mobile GPU (up to 175 W), 32 GB DDR5, 2 TB NVMe, 99 Wh battery and 2.5K 240 Hz OLED display, priced from $4,899.

stories.h: PCWorld names MSI MPG 272URX best gaming monitor
stories.s: PCWorld's 2026 roundup lists the MSI MPG 272URX QD‑OLED as the top gaming monitor, highlighting its 26.5‑inch 4K panel, 240 Hz refresh rate and $1,099.99 price.

stories.h: Linux 7.4 to add Device Tree support for three Snapdragon X2 Elite laptops
stories.s: The upcoming Linux 7.4 merge window will include DT patches for the ASUS Zenbook A14 UX3407NA, Lenovo Yoga Slim 7x Gen11, and HP EliteBook X G2q 14 AI, enabling initial boot support for Snapdragon X2 Elite SoCs.

stories.h: Intel posts v2 Linux driver patches for HDMI 2.1 FRL on Meteor Lake and newer
stories.s: Intel engineer Ankit Nautiyal released second‑iteration patches adding HDMI 2.1 Fixed Rate Link support, pipe joiner, and audio prune, now testing 4K@120 on Panther Lake, but full mainline merge expected not before 2027.

stories.h: Linux kernel adds workaround for AMD TLBI erratum #1718
stories.s: Linux 7.3-rc7 includes a software fix forcing TLBSYNC to mitigate AMD TLBI erratum #1718, which can cause TLB invalidation failures on older microcode versions; backports will follow for prior kernels.

stories.h: Microsoft adds para-virtualized IOMMU driver for Hyper-V to Linux kernel
stories.s: Microsoft contributed a para-virtualized IOMMU driver (hv-iommu-guest) for Hyper-V, enabling in‑kernel DMA protection and device assignment for Linux guests, supporting Intel VT‑d and AMD IOMMU.

stories.h: AMD PerfOpt feature in Linux 7.4 boosts prior‑gen Ryzen 7 PRO 7840U AI performance up to 23%
stories.s: Benchmarks on a Lenovo ThinkPad P14s Gen 4 with Ryzen 7 PRO 7840U show AMD's new PerfOpt IOMMU optimization in Linux 7.4 can improve AI workloads by 18–23% when enabled.

stories.h: AMD details EPYC 8005 Sorano SKU lineup and performance specs
stories.s: ServeTheHome outlines the 7 SKUs of AMD's EPYC 8005 Sorano server CPUs, covering core counts from 8 to 84, 4.5 GHz max turbo, DDR5, PCIe Gen5 and power/TDP details.

stories.h: SPECviewperf 15.0.1 Linux Edition released with Arm AArch64 support
stories.s: SPECviewperf 15.0.1 Linux Edition adds a new GUI, snap‑in workloads and native support for Arm AArch64, marking the first Linux benchmark on Arm‑based systems.

stories.h: GMKtec launches EVO-X3 mini‑PC with AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395, 128GB LPDDR5X
stories.s: The new EVO‑X3 mini‑PC features an AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 (16C/32T, 5.1GHz), 128GB LPDDR5X‑8000 memory, Radeon 8060S iGPU and an OCuLink port for external PCIe devices.

stories.h: Microsoft to stop Windows Update on PCs missing certificate rotation by May 17/June 19 2027
stories.s: Microsoft will replace Windows Update certificates; PCs that don't receive the July 2026 or later updates will lose access to Windows Update after the current certificates expire on May 17 and June 19 2027.

stories.h: AMD Raises GDDR6 Memory Prices for Board Partners
stories.s: AMD has reportedly increased the price of GDDR6 memory supplied to its AIB partners effective Oct 1, likely pushing up retail GPU prices, especially in China where Radeon cards already saw price hikes.

stories.h: NVIDIA Stops GB202 Chip Allocation to RTX 5090, Shifts to Workstation GPUs
stories.s: NVIDIA is reportedly ending RTX 5090 production, redirecting its GB202 silicon to RTX Pro workstation cards, while an RTX 5080 24 GB will become the top GeForce model; the 5090 launched at $1,999 and now sells for up to €5,000.

stories.h: AOC launches U27G4Z 27" dual-mode 4K/1080p gaming monitor with 240 Hz/480 Hz refresh rates
stories.s: AOC unveiled the 27‑inch U27G4Z in China, featuring a Fast IPS panel that runs at 240 Hz 4K or 480 Hz 1080p, 1 ms GtG, 0.3 ms MPRT, HDR400, and NVIDIA G‑SYNC compatibility, but pricing and global availability are not announced yet.

stories.h: Counterfeit RTX 4090 with fake die and memory sold for $350 in Russia
stories.s: A Russian GPU repair specialist discovered a fake RTX 4090 PCB with a dummy GPU die and GDDR6 chips masquerading as GDDR6X, sold for about $350. The scam involved detailed counterfeit labeling and BGA soldering.

stories.h: Modder shows GPU repositioning can cut hotspot temps by up to 19°C
stories.s: Enthusiast TrashBench repositioned an RTX 3080 in a desktop, achieving a 19°C reduction in GPU hotspot temperature and up to 3.3°C cooler CPU in certain configs.

stories.h: SanDisk NAS 800 1.92TB SSD reviewed with up to 14,900 MB/s read and 13,200 MB/s write
stories.s: Tom's Hardware reviewed the SanDisk NAS 800 series, noting its high endurance (3,500 TBW for 1.92 TB), PCIe 5.0 x4 performance up to 14,900 MB/s read and 13,200 MB/s write, and a premium price of $699.99.

stories.h: Cryptomining malware PoeLLM infects over 3,400 servers using poem‑based C2 addresses
stories.s: Lumen's Black Lotus Labs report that PoeLLM cryptomining malware has compromised more than 3,400 servers, targeting AI/LLM services like LiteLLM and Ollama via a poem‑encoded C2 mechanism.

stories.h: Super Micro broker pleads guilty to smuggling Nvidia AI chips to China
stories.s: Ting-Wei “Willy” Sun pleaded guilty to conspiring with Super Micro co‑founder Yih‑Shyan “Wally” Liaw and sales manager Ruei‑Tsang “Steven” Chang to divert Nvidia AI chips to China, using fake paperwork and altered server shells.

stories.h: Gigabyte GO27Q24G 27" OLED monitor launches at $350 with 240 Hz QHD
stories.s: Tom's Hardware reviews the Gigabyte GO27Q24G, a 27‑inch QHD 240 Hz OLED gaming monitor priced at $350, noting its high brightness, 10‑bit color and solid build despite missing USB ports and speakers.

stories.h: AMD unveils Helion rack design supporting up to 32,768 Zen 6 cores
stories.s: AMD announced the Helion reference rack, a 21‑inch OCP‑compliant design that can house up to 128 EPYC 9996 CPUs for a total of 32,768 Zen 6 cores, with options for liquid cooling and hybrid GPU configurations.
